# Multiplayer & Constitution Compliance Quality Checklist: End-to-End In-Game Verification (Gate 3)

**Purpose**: Validate that the multiplayer requirements (Constitution VI) and constitution compliance requirements are complete, clear, consistent, and measurable — testing the requirements themselves, not whether the implementation satisfies them.
**Created**: 2026-10-25
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command. Items test whether multiplayer/constitution requirements are well-written, not whether the implementation complies.

## Constitution Compliance Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 - Are all six constitution principles (I–VI) addressed in the spec? [Completeness, Spec §Dependencies, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK002 - Is Principle I (DDD) compliance verified (no domain logic in controllers, service layer preserved)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK003 - Is Principle II (Security) compliance verified (path sanitization, no raw exceptions)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001b]
- [ ] CHK004 - Is Principle III (Async-Only) compliance verified (no .Result/.Wait() in growth modifier)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK005 - Is Principle IV (TDD) compliance verified (red-phase tests, rewrite to pass)? [Completeness, Spec §Dependencies, §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK006 - Is Principle V (YAGNI) compliance verified (only save comparator in scope, 3 deferred)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001a, §FR-003a]
- [ ] CHK007 - Is Principle VI (Multiplayer) compliance verified (host guard, idempotency, farm-scoped)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002a, §Clarifications Round 3]

## Host Authority Requirements

- [ ] CHK008 - Is the host guard condition specified with exact check (`Context.IsMainPlayer`)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK009 - Is the host guard location specified (top of OnDayEnding, before any processing)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK010 - Is the farmhand behavior specified (skip execution, no growth modifier)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002a]
- [ ] CHK011 - Is the single-player degenerate case specified (host with no clients)? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions, Constitution §VI]
- [ ] CHK012 - Is the host authority requirement consistent with Constitution VI ("host is single source of truth")? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002a, Constitution §VI]

## Notes

- Items marked `[Gap]` indicate requirements that may be missing from the spec
- Items marked `[Ambiguity]` indicate potential clarifications needed
- Review ownership: reviewer marks `[x]` only after confirming the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate but does not modify markers
- This checklist focuses on requirements quality for multiplayer/constitution compliance, not implementation verification
